free_tier_limits: Free for non-commercial use with required TMDB attribution; commercial use requires a separate license.
paid_plans: Commercial licensing is available by contacting TMDB sales; public fixed pricing is not published.
rate_limits: Legacy 40-per-10-second limiting is disabled, but TMDB retains a soft upper limit around 40 requests/second and clients must honor HTTP 429 responses; this may change.
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: auditor right — FAQ: free for non-commercial with attribution (https://developer.themoviedb.org/docs/faq). paid_plans: auditor right — commercial via sales@themoviedb.org / api-for-business; no public fixed prices on official pages (https://developer.themoviedb.org/docs/faq, https://www.themoviedb.org/api-for-business). rate_limits: auditor right — docs: legacy 40/10s disabled; soft ~40 rps; honor 429 (https://developer.themoviedb.org/docs/rate-limiting).
